name: API Sync Go
author: hi@vhming.com
description: High-performance Go API service for syncing user profiles, avatars, and data from 7gc-portal MariaDB with Redis caching. Auto-clones and builds from source.

startup_commands.Default: if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = "1" ] || [ ! -f ./${SERVER_BINARY} ]; then mkdir -p .cache/go .cache/gocache .cache/tmp; export GOPATH="$(pwd)/.cache/go"; export GOCACHE="$(pwd)/.cache/gocache"; export GOTMPDIR="$(pwd)/.cache/tmp"; export CGO_ENABLED=0; if [ -d .git ] && command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[Startup] Pulling latest code..."; git pull; fi; if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f go.mod ]; then echo "[Startup] Building ${SERVER_BINARY}..."; go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ./${SERVER_BINARY} ./cmd/server && rm -rf .cache; fi; fi; chmod +x ./${SERVER_BINARY} && ./${SERVER_BINARY} -port ${SERVER_PORT}

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone and build from source.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Git branch to clone and checkout.

variables.name: Auto Update & Rebuild on Start
variables.description: Set to 1 to run git pull and rebuild binary with go build on each server restart.

variables.name: API Keys
variables.description: Comma-separated API keys for X-API-KEY client authentication.

variables.name: Allowed Origin / Domain
variables.description: Allowed domain for CORS requests (e.g. acsync.vhming.dev, localhost:3005). NO fallback.

variables.name: Redis Connection URL
variables.description: Redis connection URL (e.g. redis://127.0.0.1:6379). Note: URL-encode '@' in passwords as '%40'.

variables.name: Legacy Database Mode
variables.description: Read legacy database tables (users, user_steam_profiles, user_discord_profiles). Set to true or false.

variables.name: User Profile Cache TTL
variables.description: Cache duration for fetched user profiles (e.g. 5m, 10m, 1h).

variables.name: Negative Cache TTL
variables.description: Cache duration for non-existent users in DB (e.g. 1m, 2m).

variables.name: Avatar Cache TTL
variables.description: Cache duration for avatar image bytes (e.g. 30m, 1h).

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level: debug, info, warn, error.

variables.name: DB Max Open Connections
variables.description: Maximum open connections to MariaDB pool.

variables.name: DB Max Idle Connections
variables.description: Maximum idle connections kept in MariaDB pool.

variables.name: DB Connection Max Lifetime
variables.description: Maximum lifetime of a database connection (e.g. 5m, 10m).

variables.name: DB Connection Max Idle Time
variables.description: Maximum idle time before closing a DB connection (e.g. 2m, 5m).
